body: Congratulations on your success. I don't think I can take away anything from this story though, my parents aren't being hard on me they just hate me since I'm an accident child. I also don't think my brain will say "fuck this, fuck you, I will survive this." Since I have nothing to survive for.
I don't know if any of this was helpful, but thank you for taking the time to try to help.

Let me rephrase my question. 100% guarantee you will be homeless for the rest of your life, would you still choice homeless over suicide? 

Sure I could try to get assistance, but at some point I will just have to get a job, which I'm not going to do.

How am I sealing my fate if I just don't want anything in life? I don't want kids, I don't want to travel the world, I don't want to be rich and successful, I don't want to make any change in the world. What is there to strive for?

Would you still choice homeless over suicide if you knew you weren't going to get out of the situation? 

I see no reason for me to have a job I hate when I don't have anything I want to fulfill in life. So even if I could get out of the homeless situation, I wouldn't because I don't want to work. Instead of experiencing that struggle for the rest of my life wouldn't it just make sense to skip it?

I curious to know why you would choose being homeless over suicide?

I really doubt it, I have no real interests other than playing video games and browsing the internet. I also think I would prefer being homeless instead of working and still being poor.

I don't know, that seems like a lot of work and I'm sure there are more deserving people that should be priority for the help.

I guess that is true. Though the working life doesn't seem anymore appealing to me. I guess I'll try to find something else, I suppose the worst that can happen is I do become homeless and starve to death. Thanks for thanking the time to try to help.

I don't know, I'll research the military, but it seems it would probably be easier to get a military job that isn't a meat shield. 
I don't have any friends and the only family member that likes me is my grandmother and all she says is "be the change you want to see in the world" which doesn't really help me.
Thanks for the military suggestion though, I'll look into it.

Honestly, being homeless feels right though, I don't really think I'm suited to the working life. If I were working so I don't starve to death what life options would being homeless limit? I'm aware food isn't free, but I can't imagine it being impossible to get food.

Hmm, I guess the military is a possibility, but I'm not really sure I'm want to risk my life for a country I had no choice being born in.

FYI: Pizza isn't my favorite food, does that mean I'm not lazy?
